title: A repeated awakening study exploring the capacity of complexity measures to capture dreaming during propofol sedation
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from a repeated awakening study of propofol sedation. It examines whether EEG complexity measures can capture dreaming and subjective experience during sedation. Recordings cover wakeful eyes-open and eyes-closed rest, sedation rest, and one-minute resting periods preceding each awakening, with some sessions including transcranial magnetic stimulation.
methods_description: EEG was recorded in BrainVision format during wakefulness (eyes closed, eyes open, and TMS sessions) and during propofol sedation. Sedation sessions included repeated awakenings (runs 1-3), each preceded by a one-minute resting EEG segment.
